svg.title: Proof. Since σ5 > 0, a factorization cannot be supported on dimension two. Congruence normalization of its row factors gives a POVM P a,b Aab = I3 and density matrices bcd with Cab,cd = Tr(Aabbcd). The row sums imply Tr Aab ≥μ/9, hence a largest eigenvalue at least μ/27. Put Ra = P d bad and Qb = P c bcb. Both have trace three, and the leakage implies
